offers.requirements:
The team:

You will join the Creatives team, consisting of five more Backend engineers, two Frontend engineers, a Product Manager, and a UI/UX designer. 

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

More benefits: 

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets.

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: senior employees can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner)  will get in touch with you for an introductory call (25 minutes)

  2. Then you are going to have a tech interview with the team members (1h)

  3. For senior candidates, we schedule a system design as well (1h)

  4. After that, we will schedule a culture and role fit interview with the Creative Team Lead and one more colleague (1h)

When we don’t have enough information, we might ask you to work on a short assignment before your tech interview.
Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.


Important note: We know that in the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the first screening,  so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact from job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 to Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams

en.description:
What’s in it for you (to start with):

  • Gross monthly salary ranging from € 4.000 to € 5.700 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description!


Your challenges:

The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features.
You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust.

In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day.

  • Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team

  • Design, develop, and test new product features

  • Collaborate with and review PRs of other team members

  • Improve the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Work on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool.

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.

Who are you?

  • You have good programming skills in Haskell (or a similar typed functional language)

  • You are familiar with other programming languages and polyglot programming: we regularly need to make modifications in services written in other languages (especially Python and Rust) as well

  • You have approximately 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience 

  • You have experience in tuning and scaling a big application

  • You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, preferably Postgres

  • Good working knowledge of Linux, git, and the command line.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Haskell libraries like warp, conduit, async, servant, aeson, effectful

  • Knowledge of Rust and its ecosystem

  • Prior experience in image processing

  • Some knowledge of TypeScript/React, which we use in our WYSIWYG Image Editor

  • A passion to provide value to customers and figuring out the 'question behind the question'.

Practical requirements:

  • EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands

  • Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office.

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

offers.requirements:
Who you are

  • 3+ years closing new business in B2B SaaS, ideally in eCommerce technology, feed management, product data, or martech.

  • You understand the eCommerce tech stack, including platforms, ERPs, PIMs, marketplaces, advertising channels, and can hold a real conversation about how products get from a back-end system to a customer.

  • You've sold to operations-minded buyers (eCommerce Ops, Digital Merchandising, Catalog teams), not just marketing personas.

  • You're energized by early-stage markets where your work directly shapes the company's trajectory.

  • You qualify out as confidently as you qualify in.

Bonus points

  • Existing network in the eCommerce agency ecosystem.

  • Experience migrating customers off competitor platforms.

  • Familiarity with Google Shopping, Meta product feeds, TikTok Shop, or marketplace listing workflows.

  • You've built a personal brand or reputation in eCommerce / feed management circles.

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available full-time (40 hours/week).

  • You can periodically work from our Manhattan, NYC office on an as-needed basis.

  • You’re available to travel to events - approx. 3 trips per quarter.

Your journey at Channable

As the hub of all tool knowledge, we believe that your training and onboarding must be thorough. You will participate in 2 weeks of training at our Utrecht office in the Netherlands to familiarize yourself with the tool and your coworkers. Rest assured, we will take care of travel costs and your accommodation. Given our passion for building relationships, you won’t have to spend evenings and weekends alone if you enjoy having people around.🥂

Your buddy will be there to support you and make your training unforgettable! 😊

Who are we?

Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn! Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

What we offer

  • Real ownership of a growth market inside a profitable, scaling international SaaS company (not a cash-burning startup hoping to find PMF).

  • A defined ICP and sharpened strategy - you're not guessing who to sell to.

  • Accelerated commissions that reward outperformance generously.

  • Direct influence on GTM - your insights go straight to leadership, product, and marketing.

  • Collaborative international culture - 2 trips/year to HQ in Utrecht, Netherlands.

  • A product that handles 30 billion products monthly, is loved by customers, and keeps winning against bigger-name competitors.

  • Salary: Total OTE (100%) is between $ 200,000 and $ 250,000 gross annual based on a full-time (40 hours per week) employment. The bonus and base salary components will be discussed during the hiring process.

  • Onboarding time in Utrecht (NL): for 2 weeks to get to know the tool, our processes, and your colleagues. 😎 After that, you’ll get the trust and responsibility to show what you got. Your buddy will support you throughout the whole onboarding. ✌️

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours. ☀️

  • Buying/Paying out extra holiday days: If you want additional holidays, you can buy up to 5 extra vacation days per year. Also you can get paid out 5 vacation days per year.

  • Annual L&D budget of $1.000 to spend on anything you want to learn. You can take full advantage of this to grow professionally.

  • 401(k): Retirement plan with 5% matching.

  • Health insurance: Medical plan with the possibility to add dental-, and vision plan - 70% will be paid by Channable.

  • Commuting to our NYC office? No problem, we got you covered (TransitChek). 🚆

  • You have free & anonymous access to the OpenUp platform and psychologists. This free service is also available to your family members.

  • Flexible working days: Start your work days between 8.00 - 10.00 am, and finish working between 16.30 - 18.30 pm.

  • Channaweekend - Every year we go for a long weekend with all our colleagues from all over the world 💜

  • Channaweek - We believe in bringing people together. That’s why we organize global events like Channaweek where our entire international team gathers in Utrecht to connect and learn from one another.

  • Additional working conditions like massages, in-office bar (Channabar), and lunch (on the days you’re in the office)! 🥪

How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? Please apply by clicking on the "apply now" button below. Please send your application in English.

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, our Talent Acquisition Specialist will get in touch with you for an introduction call (25 minutes).

  2. After that, you’ll be invited for an interview with Ben (30 minutes).

  3. Jake will also have a quick chat with you (30 minutes).

  4. Next, you'll have an assignment interview with Jake & Ben (60 minutes).

  5. Finally, you’ll have a coffee chat with the team in our Midtown Manhattan office (60 minutes). ☕

  6. Please note that after the interviews, and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.

We consider applications as they come in!

Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of $250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration. We believe in diverse and inclusive teams.

en.description:
Channable powers product feeds and digital advertising for 14,000+ brands and agencies across 3,500+ channels. We're a market leader entering our next phase of North American growth.  We need an AE who knows eCommerce technology, builds real relationships, and wants to own a market, not just a quota.

The opportunity

Our North American business is growing fast. The team is small, the market is massive, and the company has the product maturity and global footprint to back serious ambition. You'll have direct influence on how we go to market, who we target, and how we win.

We sell to eCommerce operators and the agencies that serve them. Our buyers care about product data, feed quality, and operational efficiency. If you've sold into the infrastructure layer of eCommerce (the systems that make products show up correctly, everywhere, at scale), you'll feel at home here.

Your role

Full-cycle Account Executive. You build a pipeline, run your own process with help from solutions engineering and Technical Account Management, and close. 

Two motions:

  1. Brand-direct - Mid-market and enterprise eCommerce teams managing large product catalogs across multiple channels and systems.

  2. Agency - Performance and eCommerce agencies where one partnership can land many accounts.

You'll work alongside a tight North American team (Sales, CS, Support) and report to your Sales Team Lead.

What you'll do

  • Build pipeline in the right places. You know where eCommerce operators spend their time - partner ecosystems, industry communities, targeted events - and you get in those rooms. You don't rely on spray-and-pray outbound.

  • Run a consultative sales process. You diagnose before you prescribe. You understand your prospect's tech stack, data challenges, and channel strategy before you demo.

  • Close deals that stick. You qualify well and sell outcomes. Your customers renew because you matched them to real value, not because you oversold.

  • Grow the agency channel. You see the leverage in agency partnerships - one great relationship compounds into many accounts over time.

  • Shape the GTM. You bring market signals back to the team. What you learn in calls directly influences positioning, product priorities, and campaign strategy.

  • Hit and exceed your number. The market opportunity is real and the ICP is defined. High performers will over-earn here.

offers.title: Account Executive - North America
offers.description:
Channable powers product feeds and digital advertising for 14,000+ brands and agencies across 3,500+ channels. We're a market leader entering our next phase of North American growth.  We need an AE who knows eCommerce technology, builds real relationships, and wants to own a market, not just a quota.

The opportunity

Our North American business is growing fast. The team is small, the market is massive, and the company has the product maturity and global footprint to back serious ambition. You'll have direct influence on how we go to market, who we target, and how we win.

We sell to eCommerce operators and the agencies that serve them. Our buyers care about product data, feed quality, and operational efficiency. If you've sold into the infrastructure layer of eCommerce (the systems that make products show up correctly, everywhere, at scale), you'll feel at home here.

Your role

Full-cycle Account Executive. You build a pipeline, run your own process with help from solutions engineering and Technical Account Management, and close. 

Two motions:

  1. Brand-direct - Mid-market and enterprise eCommerce teams managing large product catalogs across multiple channels and systems.

  2. Agency - Performance and eCommerce agencies where one partnership can land many accounts.

You'll work alongside a tight North American team (Sales, CS, Support) and report to your Sales Team Lead.

What you'll do

  • Build pipeline in the right places. You know where eCommerce operators spend their time - partner ecosystems, industry communities, targeted events - and you get in those rooms. You don't rely on spray-and-pray outbound.

  • Run a consultative sales process. You diagnose before you prescribe. You understand your prospect's tech stack, data challenges, and channel strategy before you demo.

  • Close deals that stick. You qualify well and sell outcomes. Your customers renew because you matched them to real value, not because you oversold.

  • Grow the agency channel. You see the leverage in agency partnerships - one great relationship compounds into many accounts over time.

  • Shape the GTM. You bring market signals back to the team. What you learn in calls directly influences positioning, product priorities, and campaign strategy.

  • Hit and exceed your number. The market opportunity is real and the ICP is defined. High performers will over-earn here.

offers.requirements:
What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 77k-103k, including 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework.

  • Savings for old age: we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: you can profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year.

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 

How can you introduce yourself to us?
Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered.
If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner) will get in touch with you for an introductory call. After that, you'll be invited for interviews. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

en.description:
About the role:


We are looking for a new team lead for one of the teams within our Infra Platform Group. Your mission in this role is to architect and deliver foundational services that empower the product engineering teams building our e-commerce platform.

Together with your team, you will be tackling challenging engineering problems, working on high-performing and scalable services written in Haskell and Rust, while also providing a high-quality developer experience for the teams that use them via Python.


Your time will be split approximately 50-50 between leadership tasks and hands-on development. In your leadership role, you are a mentor to your team members, unblocking them when they face challenging roadblocks, and you help them grow both their hard and soft skills. As part of your hands-on work, you are contributing to the architecture and the ongoing development and maintenance of our services.

You will initially be managing a team of four experienced Haskell and Rust engineers, and you will be working closely together with the other teams in the group, the engineering manager of the Infra Platform Group, and the stakeholders from other engineering teams that consume our services.

If you don't have direct experience with Haskell, but you have solid experience with Rust or Scala and a willingness to learn Haskell, please submit your application, as we are still happy to consider it!

Your responsibilities:

Your Team Lead tasks will include:

  • Organizing the work and managing priorities

  • Collaborating with the other team leads in the Infra Platform Group on the long-term roadmap

  • Mentoring team members, helping them grow and holding half-yearly performance reviews with them

  • Setting up project teams and mentor project leads

  • Hiring new team members

  • Implementing and improving upon our processes for the team 

  • Establishing the team culture and fostering a collaborative environment

Your Development tasks will include:

  • Designing, developing and testing new features in our services

  • Improving the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Working on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborating with and review PRs of other engineers

  • Breaking down big projects into smaller issues

  • Writing clear and actionable issues

  • Debugging and fixing issues, and teaching team members to do the same

  • Working together with our product engineering teams and DevOps team on requirements and issues


Who are you?

You like working in a dynamic team of skilled engineers, discussing technical decisions openly and collaboratively. It is easy for you to break down big issues into smaller tasks and to prioritize work pragmatically.

To set you up for success in this role, we think you'll benefit from having the following skills and experience:

  • You have previous experience leading an engineering team, or you are an experienced engineer, excited to start your career as a leader.

  • You can give detailed code reviews both from a high-level and a low-level perspective.

  • You have the technical depth to help your team members grow and can remove roadblocks for them.

  • You have substantial backend development experience, you are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • You are familiar with relational databases (ideally PostgreSQL), Linux and git.

  • You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs

  • You have strong communication and problem-solving skills

  • You are a people-oriented individual who helps others with an open and approachable attitude.

  • You value high software engineering standards.

  • You are pragmatic and empathic towards your team members and other stakeholders (i.e. colleagues from other departments etc).

  • You like helping the team focus on the most important tasks, making sure its priorities and plans align with the rest of the company (we use the OKR framework for this).

Practical requirements:

  • EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands

  • Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office

Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.
